title: Inside the Quiet Rhythm of a Horse Herd
caption:
Real horses across Iceland, meadows and woodland: how their daily routines change by place and season. Separate original recordings. #WildVox #Horses #Nature #AnimalBehavior

narration_timeline.text: These Icelandic horses gather close together, each facing a different part of the field.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic group of Icelandic horses in one recording

narration_timeline.text: Elsewhere, a horse lowers its head and grazes through green grass.
narration_timeline.scene: A genuine close horse grazing in California

narration_timeline.text: In two spring recordings, one pale horse drinks at the water's edge while another horse grazes alone beside the shore.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate recordings: a pale horse drinking at the shoreline and a single tan horse grazing beside the water; no group movement claimed.

narration_timeline.text: On another part of the shore, the herd shifts position across open ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual additional Camargue horses on lakeside ground

narration_timeline.text: Later spring footage shows other horses moving through meadow grass and pausing between mouthfuls.
narration_timeline.scene: Two separate authentic Camargue horses in the spring meadow

narration_timeline.text: In a separate summer scene, a white horse grazes among trees, following its own relaxed daily rhythm.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual single white horse feeding among trees near woodland; no invented group by a lake.
